messages:
alex_sales: StratusPay sent over a filled questionnaire + CAIQ export and asked for an estimated POC timeframe. link: https://drive.google.com/stratuspack :paperclip:
mina_security: grabbing it. quick check: do they require BYOK or just encrypted-at-rest? the CAIQ field is vague.
ryan_solutions: they tagged 'customer-managed keys' in the intake form. asked for clarification on which KMS.
infra-bot: Ticket created: RWI-4920 2D security-intake. Assigned to mina_security.
mina_security: ok i'll triage. immediate asks: KMS vendor + key policy, SOC2 evidence, data classification (PII/PHI), and a redacted pen test.
olga_engineer: engineering FYI: if BYOK = AWS KMS or Azure KV we can do a hosted-demo with region pinning. other vendors will need platform lead time.
alex_sales: told customer short window for POC (2 weeks). asked them to confirm KMS ARN and whether PHI will be used in the demo (72h deadline).
ryan_solutions: also asked for network diagram showing any on-prem connections. that's often missing.
mina_security: posting checklist I'll attach to RWI-4920:
```
- KMS ARN + key policy
- SOC2 PDF + scope
- Data classification (PII/PHI)
- Redacted pen test summary
- Network/dataflow diagram for POC
```
alex_sales: customer replied: "we'll provide AWS ARNs and SOC2, no PHI in demo" 2D sending now. :thumbsup:
mina_security: great. i'll validate the ARNs and SOC2 scope. if all clear i'll mark as low risk and unblock POC scheduling.
olga_engineer: once ARNs validated, ops needs a 4-hour maintenance window to attach keys for the demo. estimate: 0.5 engineer-days.
mina_security: i'll update the ticket and follow up with required evidence list. thanks all.
